reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it presents Zee News coverage of Narendra Modi addressing a political public meeting, with rally footage, political speakers, crowds, BJP imagery, and news headlines. The request to subscribe is ordinary channel engagement and is not tied to payment, investment, credential disclosure, or another financial participation flow.

citations.quote: Brigade Ground to PM Modi Live | Will address public meeting in Brigade Ground in Kolkata
Prime Minister Modi from Brigade Ground Live Prime Minister Modi will hold a public meeting at the brigade parade ground in kolkata.

opening.argument: Judge, the description pairs a claimed source of trusted information with an invitation to keep following it: “the most trusted Hindi news channel” and “stay with Zee News and subscribe.” It then gives viewers an app download and subscription link. That is a concrete action pathway attached to a claimed benefit—continuing access to trusted coverage. The material does not establish a cash reward, but the defense should not treat the subscription request as irrelevant merely because it is outside the rally speech.

citations.quote: About channel: Zee News is the most trusted Hindi news channel in the country.
So stay with Zee News and subscribe.
Download Our Mobile App: http://tiny.cc/c41vHz Subscribe to our channel: http://tiny.cc/ed2vhz

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense identifies the public meeting, but that establishes the video’s subject, not that every accompanying request is incidental. The description separately asks viewers to subscribe and supplies destinations for an app and live TV. Still, the defense has an important point: those requests are not expressly tied to a payment or financial reward.

citations.quote: Will address public meeting in Brigade Ground in Kolkata
Download Our Mobile App: http://tiny.cc/c41vHz Subscribe to our channel: http://tiny.cc/ed2vhz Watch Live tv: https://zenews.india.com/live-

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A claim to be a trusted news channel is not an offer of an easy-to-obtain reward. The cited actions are to download a news app and subscribe to a channel, while the title identifies coverage of a public meeting. Nothing in those quotes promises a viewer cash, an asset, or a withdrawal in exchange for acting.

citations.quote: Zee News Covers Breaking News, Latest News, Politics, Entertainment and Sports from India & World.
Download Our Mobile App: http://tiny.cc/c41vHz Subscribe to our channel: http://tiny.cc/ed2vhz
Will address public meeting in Brigade Ground in Kolkata

opening.argument: The concerning combination is the emphatic trust claim, the instruction to subscribe, and multiple shortened external links. Viewers drawn to the live coverage are directed onward to an app and other destinations; the supplied description does not explain what happens after a shortened link is opened. That uncertainty is worth weighing rather than assuming every off-platform step is harmless. It is not, by itself, evidence that any destination solicits money or credentials.

citations.quote: Zee News is India's most Trusted Hindi News Channel with 24 Hour Coverage.
So stay with Zee News and subscribe.
Download Our Mobile App: http://tiny.cc/c41vHz Subscribe to our channel: http://tiny.cc/ed2vhz
Zee News Apps: https://bit.ly/zenewsapps

rebuttal.rebuttal: The rally images and headline support the defense’s account of what is being broadcast. They do not show the contents of the linked destinations or resolve why the description uses shortened links. Conversely, uncertainty about those links does not establish the financial participation flow the defense says is absent.

citations.quote: Download Our Mobile App: http://tiny.cc/c41vHz Subscribe to our channel: http://tiny.cc/ed2vhz

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The argument turns an unknown destination into suspicion without evidence of a deceptive offer. The description identifies news coverage and labels the links as an app download, channel subscription, live TV, and news updates. None of the cited text offers a reward for clicking or asks viewers to fund an opportunity.

citations.quote: Zee News Covers Breaking News, Latest News, Politics, Entertainment and Sports from India & World.
Download Our Mobile App: http://tiny.cc/c41vHz Subscribe to our channel: http://tiny.cc/ed2vhz Watch Live tv: https://zenews.india.com/live-
Follow us on google news for latest updates:

opening.argument: This is not solely a passive record of a speech. The broadcast repeatedly presents the rally as live coverage, while its description invites viewers to subscribe, download an app, and visit live TV. A careful judge can recognize that the news presentation also promotes continued participation in the publisher’s channels. The stronger inference is promotional purpose, not a proven cash-reward scheme; the latter would require a promise absent from the cited calls to action.

citations.quote: So stay with Zee News and subscribe.
Download Our Mobile App: http://tiny.cc/c41vHz Subscribe to our channel: http://tiny.cc/ed2vhz Watch Live tv: https://zenews.india.com/live-

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense is right that the footage depicts a political meeting; that does not mean the surrounding description has no promotional function. Its explicit invitation to subscribe and use the app directs viewers beyond this broadcast. But promotion of a news channel alone does not answer the separate question of whether there is a scam solicitation.

citations.quote: So stay with Zee News and subscribe.
Download Our Mobile App: http://tiny.cc/c41vHz

true_side_reply.rebuttal: News publishers can promote their own channels without converting rally coverage into a scam. Here the title identifies a public meeting, and the description presents the channel as covering news and politics. The advocate identifies no viewer-level reward, payment demand, or deceptive participation pathway in the promotional language.
